programme.desc: A judge tries to save a female innocent who's wrongly being accused for murder.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This film tells the story of a Chinese illegal immigrant, Cheung Kwan-chow, and his journey in New York.

programme.title: Open The Coffin
programme.desc: A supernatural mystery film with a detective investigating murders that seem to be the result of a curse.

programme.title: Young Heroes Of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: A Monkey King is reincarnated in the un human form as Joker, a highwayman oblivious to his original identity and the fact that 500 years earlier, he and his master, the Longevity Monk, were punished and made to stay human.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Brilliant director Sun Chung and the majestic Ti Lung reunite for a thriller about an aging fighter who relives his violent past mistakes through a streetwise kid.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: This refreshing musical comedy tempers its fizzy charm with just enough tartness to insure its charming buoyancy. This light look at teenage life even won starlet Chou Hsiu-lan a Hong Kong Film Awards nomination for Best Newcomer.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Kung Fu Jungle follows a martial arts instructor who is imprisoned after a fatal accident. When a serial killer begins targeting martial arts masters, he offers his help to the police in exchange for freedom. A deadly game of skill and survival unfolds as he confronts the killer using his mastery of kung fu.

programme.title: Mother Vs Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: An imperial agent gets ridiculed for his various inventions, until his supportive wife encourages him to attend a conference, which's actually a trap to kill all the doctors serving the emperor, where his crazy inventions come in handy.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap.

Dengan Gaya Penyajian Yang Ringan, Menghibur, Dan Penuh Humor, Ijin, Ndan Tetap Konsisten Menyampaikan Fakta Aktual Dan Pesan Edukatif Kepada Penonton, Menjadikannya Tontonan Yang Informatif Sekaligus Mengundang Tawa.

Dia Mengetahui Bahwa Ayahnya, Ging Freecss, Adalah Seorang Hunter Legendaris.
